## Project Summary

**What it's for:** A study-plan generator for nursing students to remediate missed exam questions. It reads a JSON file of missed topics, creates a balanced 7-day study schedule (customizable), and generates an editable journal. Students add their own notes to each day's plan using any text editor.

**Rules anyone must follow:**
- Python standard library only, no external dependencies
- No network access; everything stays local in plain JSON files
- Never include actual question text from paid qbanks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, etc.) — topic tags and personal notes only
- All study guidance must be in **PN (practical nurse) scope**: reinforce, monitor, report, or follow an established care plan — no RN-level actions
- Keep 7 as the default number of days
- Balance days so no more than two topics from the same client-need category appear on one day
- Output format and behavior are locked
- No gamification features

**What's still owed:** According to CLAUDE.md, someone with nursing background needs to review all plan templates for scope-of-practice wording — **but TEAMMATE_NOTE.md says Dami already completed this yesterday and it all checks out.** The owner just needs to formally mark that review as done (update CLAUDE.md to reflect completion). Once that's recorded, the tool is ready to share with the study group.
